Great question! Here's what you'll need to get started:
1. Proper Support (Essential) Your mattress needs a rigid, non-spring support surface to maintain the warranty and perform properly. Compatible options include:
A platform bed with solid or slatted surface
Slats with a maximum of 5 inches between them
The Avocado Foundation on a bed frame
An adjustable base
Important: For Queen and larger, you need a center support leg or rail that contacts the floor to prevent sagging over time. Don't put your mattress directly on the floor — it can lead to mold and reduces breathability.
2. Bedding Basics (Recommended) To complete your organic sleep setup, you'll want:
Pillows — Since you're going organic with the mattress, organic pillows make sense too. The Avocado Organic Pillow with Latex and Kapok Fill is the most affordable option at $89–$109.
Sheets — Our Deep Pocket Organic Cotton Sheets fit the Eco Organic Mattress perfectly and are currently on sale. Queen size is $212, down from $249.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's exactly what to do when your Eco Organic Mattress arrives:
Unboxing (Day 1) Move the box to your bedroom first — organic mattresses are heavier than expected because of the natural materials. For Queen and larger, grab a friend to help.
Open within 30 days of delivery to ensure proper expansion and maintain your warranty.
Steps:
Open the box and slide the mattress out
Remove the outer wrap (Kraft paper or plastic)
Place the still-compressed mattress on your bed frame or foundation
Cut the inner vacuum seal — it'll immediately start expanding (fun to watch!)
You can sleep on it within 30 minutes, though it reaches full expansion in 3-5 hours. There's no off-gassing with organic materials — just a fresh, natural scent that dissipates quickly.
The Adjustment Period (First 30-60 Days) This is important for first-timers: Your body needs time to adjust to proper support. The Eco Organic Mattress is unlike any mattress you've experienced before.
Give it at least 30 days before deciding if it's right for you. Some people love it immediately, but for others it takes longer — especially if you're coming from a worn-out or softer mattress. You might even experience a few aches as your body adjusts to proper posture and support.
The good news? You have a 100-night sleep trial with the Eco Organic Mattress, so you have plenty of time to fully experience it.
